purpose: Current working-tree baseline before paper-inspired memory redesign
notes: Source working tree and original index are preserved.
Runtime state, cache, raw experiments, build outputs and downloaded papers are excluded.
Required frozen reference archive and default-test fixtures are retained.
The exported .gitignore adds publication exclusions; the remaining copied source files are byte-identical before Git newline normalization.
This records a source baseline, not new quality acceptance or a deployed desktop version.
